meaning_sources: 사용자 제공 검증된 의미: 8단계 家家戶戶 의미·대본 검수 지시 (2026-10-20)

panels.scene: A village festival is beginning. A child in hanbok sees festive decorations hanging on several traditional Korean houses.
The child and a friend, both in hanbok, look together at the beautifully decorated houses throughout the village.
The friend points toward the village houses, showing the child how every household has prepared festive decorations.
A wide view shows the whole traditional Korean village filled with festival decorations. The child and friend stand smiling in the foreground, enjoying the festive atmosphere.
